authors: Hugo Seuté; Pranai Vasudev; Etienne Richan; Louis-Xavier Buffoni

summary_en: Introduces Reciprocal Latent Fields, a volumetric latent representation with symmetric decoders that enforces acoustic reciprocity while compressing precomputed wave-based sound-propagation parameters by several orders of magnitude. A Riemannian decoder improves reproduction of path distances and acoustic quantities, enabling near-instant runtime inference with perceptual quality reported as indistinguishable from ground-truth wave coding.
